name: Romega ATS — Resume Extractor (Regex, No API Key)

parameters.formDescription: Upload a PDF or DOCX resume to extract candidate information automatically.

parameters.content:
## Programmatic POST works too

This form trigger also accepts POSTs from your own app:

```
POST  https://<n8n-host>/form/<path-uuid>
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Fields:
  - "Resume File"   (file, required)
  - "Candidate ID"  (text, optional)
```

Response: JSON via the Success Response / Error Response nodes (responseMode = responseNode).
